Chapter 789: Chapter 11: Divine Might (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 789: Chapter 11: Divine Might (Subscribe Please)

Above the vast firmament.

Two immensely huge Foreign Evil Gods, with half their bodies already squeezing into Tianqing World.

At this moment, their hearts trembled slightly. As Evil Gods who fed on worlds, their senses were exceptionally sharp.

But now they sensed a dire threat of impending disaster.

It was for this reason that they retreated without hesitation.

Even though half of their feet had entered the world, forcibly exiting would cause them to collide directly with the world’s barrier.

...

Resulting in minor injuries, they hesitated not at all.

“That Demon Tree, it actually had such a terrifying ace up its sleeve?”

Both Foreign Evil Gods found it unbelievable.

Even though they had not identified the exact nature of the threat, they knew without question that it came from within Tianqing World,

and had something to do with the Ancestral Demon Tree.

This, even more, perplexed the two Foreign Evil Gods.

If the Ancestral Demon Tree had such a trump card, why didn’t it use it earlier?

Why wait until now, when Tianqing World’s barrier itself had been torn apart?

…

Deep within the Boundless Void.

Several Foreign Evil Gods, too, were paying attention to the invaded Tianqing World.

In just a few hundred thousand years, the Origin Source of Tianqing World had surged tenfold, naturally inciting the envy of many Foreign Evil Gods.

Unfortunately, Tianqing World had already caught the eye of the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master.

The Black Demon Pavilion Master, more than a hundred thousand years ago in a Void Secret Realm, had gained a crucial opportunity.

His power surged dramatically.

He had already become the most powerful Evil God in this region.

Since the Black Demon Pavilion Master had set his sights on Tianqing World, these Evil Gods, despite their envy, dared not interfere.

“Who knows, what secrets are within that world.”

“That demon, ignoring the commands of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, stubbornly guards inside the world; now look what happened.”

The numerous Foreign Evil Gods felt somewhat schadenfreude, watching from afar, especially seeing the two Evil Gods guarding outside the world, already unwilling to wait for their True Bodies to descend, it seemed like they had foreseen the Demon Tree’s fate.

However, it was not long before.

Some Foreign Evil Gods sensed something amiss.

“Eh? How come ‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ are escaping?”

‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ were under the command of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, assigned to conquer Tianqing World.

Initially, when many Evil Gods saw ‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ planning to descend their True Bodies into the world, they thought the situation was settled.

But now, the Evil Gods saw ‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’, who were frantically squeezing into the world, retreating desperately as if facing some primordial ferocious beast.

“Interesting, what has changed?”

“Does that Demon Tree have any other cards up its sleeve?”

“Indeed, to allow a world’s Origin Source to surge tenfold, there must be some secret.”

The numerous Foreign Evil Gods immediately speculated the reason; most of them were frenzied, yet not foolish, possessing normal reasoning ability.

“Watch.”

“Right, let’s just watch.”

The Foreign Evil Gods didn’t care; they feared the Black Demon Pavilion Master but were pleased to see ‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ falter.

After all, it wasn’t their concern; if the invasion encountered unexpected variables, the numerous Foreign Evil Gods were just onlookers.

…

Within Tianqing World.

Lin Yuan’s figure hovered in the air, where his gaze reached, endless Evil God Puppets turned to ash and smoke.

These Evil God Puppets were transformations of the Evil God’s power; Evil Gods could devour a world, but likewise, the world could also devour Evil Gods.

However, unlike the Evil Gods with their independent consciousness, the world’s consciousness could not resist directly.

It could only indirectly counter them through the form of ‘Children of the World’ or ‘Children of Fortune’.

But now, under Lin Yuan’s control, all the powers left behind after the annihilation of the Evil God Puppets were devoured by the world’s Origin Source.

“This body…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes narrowed slightly; the body he now inhabited was nourished and condensed by the infinite Origin Source of Tianqing World.

Not only was it incredibly profound, but it could also mobilize all forces within the world.

“Thinking of leaving?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the two Foreign Evil Gods, struggling to push themselves out, his thoughts stirring slightly, the world’s power of Tianqing World transformed into sharp spatial blades, slashing directly towards them.

“Not good.”

The one to bear the brunt was ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’; it had been the first to push into the world, and most of its body was already inside; being severed in half would mean only a smaller portion could escape.

Though such an injury was not fatal for a Foreign Evil God, it was unknown how long it would take to recover.

“Please, Pavilion Master, lend your aid.”

‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ didn’t hesitate to pull out a statue, a creature with eighteen arms, which, even as just a statue, emitted an aura that could drive countless beings into madness and oblivion.

This was the last-resort trump card given by the Black Demon Pavilion Master, usable only three times.

Having already used it once during the initial assault on Tianqing World, only two chances remained.

Given the character of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, once given, he would not take it back.

Meaning, if they could take over Tianqing World with minimal cost, this statue would belong to them.

According to ‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’s plan, they would activate the statue only once at most, saving the remaining two uses for crucial moments in the future.

But now?

‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ was vaguely sensing tremendous fear, naturally not daring to hold back.

“Is that the Black Demon Pavilion Master’s doing?”

Lin Yuan, having fully received the Ancestral Demon Tree’s memories, naturally recognized it.

It was relying on this statue that the two Foreign Evil Gods had severely injured the Ancestral Demon Tree, even tearing apart Tianqing World’s barrier, thereby plundering the lands of Tianqing World.
